cue.arrived.value: Sie sind an Ihrem Ziel angekommen
cue.arrived.description: Voice cue spoken on arrival at the destination.

cue.arrivingInM.value: Ankunft an Ihrem Ziel in {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}
cue.arrivingInM.description: Voice cue announcing imminent arrival at the destination.

cue.nextTurnInAbout.generic.value: Nächste Abbiege- oder Fahranweisung in etwa {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}
cue.nextTurnInAbout.generic.description: Voice cue announcing a generic upcoming maneuver.

cue.nextTurnInAbout.left.value: Nächste Abzweigung links in etwa {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}
cue.nextTurnInAbout.left.description: Voice cue announcing the upcoming left turn distance ahead.

cue.nextTurnInAbout.right.value: Nächste Abzweigung rechts in etwa {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}
cue.nextTurnInAbout.right.description: Voice cue announcing the upcoming right turn distance ahead.

cue.nextTurnInAbout.uturn.value: Nächster U-Turn in etwa {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}
cue.nextTurnInAbout.uturn.description: Voice cue announcing an upcoming U-turn.

cue.offTrack.description: Voice cue when the rider strays from the route.

cue.onTrack.description: Voice cue confirming the rider has returned to the route.

cue.rerouting.description: Voice cue while the app calculates a new route after going off track.

cue.routeStarted.description: Voice cue spoken once when the rider begins following a route.

cue.turn10m.exitLeft.description: Imperative voice cue at a left exit.

cue.turn10m.exitRight.description: Imperative voice cue at a right exit.

cue.turn10m.generic.description: Imperative voice cue for a generic maneuver.

cue.turn10m.keepLeft.description: Imperative voice cue at a keep-left bifurcation.

cue.turn10m.keepRight.description: Imperative voice cue at a keep-right bifurcation.

cue.turn10m.left.description: Imperative voice cue at the moment of a left turn (within ~10m).

cue.turn10m.right.description: Imperative voice cue at the moment of a right turn.

cue.turn10m.uturn.description: Imperative voice cue at a U-turn maneuver.

cue.turn50m.exitLeft.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, nimm die linke Ausfahrt
cue.turn50m.exitLeft.description: Voice cue ~50m before a left exit ramp / off-ramp.

cue.turn50m.exitRight.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, nimm die rechte Ausfahrt
cue.turn50m.exitRight.description: Voice cue ~50m before a right exit ramp / off-ramp.

cue.turn50m.generic.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, folge der Route
cue.turn50m.generic.description: Voice cue ~50m before a generic maneuver that doesn't fit the directional categories.

cue.turn50m.keepLeft.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, links halten
cue.turn50m.keepLeft.description: Voice cue ~50m before a keep-left maneuver at a bifurcation.

cue.turn50m.keepRight.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, rechts halten
cue.turn50m.keepRight.description: Voice cue ~50m before a keep-right maneuver at a bifurcation.

cue.turn50m.left.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, links abbiegen
cue.turn50m.left.description: Voice cue ~50m before a left turn. {distance} is the rounded distance to the maneuver.

cue.turn50m.right.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, rechts abbiegen
cue.turn50m.right.description: Voice cue ~50m before a right turn.

cue.turn50m.uturn.value: In {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, meters {meters} feet {feet} other {meters}}, mach einen U-Turn
cue.turn50m.uturn.description: Voice cue ~50m before a U-turn maneuver.

guidance.distanceToDestination.value: {distance, number} {distanceUnit, select, km {km} mi {mi} other {km}} bis {destination}
guidance.distanceToDestination.description: Active guidance card subtitle showing remaining distance and destination name.

home.importedRoute.description: Header above the route alternatives card when a single route was imported from a GPX file or share-extension link.

home.noSuggestions.description: Empty-state placeholder shown in the where-to dropdown when the typeahead has no results yet.

home.openSettings.description: Toolbar / button label that opens the Settings hub.

home.platformHint.locationDefault.value: Ihr Browser fragt nach einer Standortberechtigung. Erlauben Sie sie, damit die Navigation Ihre Position weiter verfolgt, während die Seite im Hintergrund ist.
home.platformHint.locationDefault.description: Hint shown under the 'Allow GPS in background' setting on every browser except Safari/iOS.

home.platformHint.locationSafariIos.value: Safari auf dem iPhone liefert kein echtes GPS im Hintergrund. Halten Sie den Tab aktiv und den Bildschirm eingeschaltet, damit Standortaktualisierungen während der Fahrt weiter erfolgen.
home.platformHint.locationSafariIos.description: Hint shown under the 'Allow GPS in background' setting when the browser is Safari on iOS.

home.recenter.description: Map button to recenter on the rider's current location.

home.routeOptions.description: Header on the route suggestions card listing alternative routes.

home.start.description: Primary button on the route suggestions card that begins the selected route.

home.startOnDevice.description: Primary route-start button label when an ESP32 device is paired and connected — the route will be sent to the device instead of started on the phone.

home.startRoute.description: Primary button to begin riding the planned route.

home.startingOnDevice.description: Transient state on the start button while the route is being transferred to a paired ESP32 device.

home.stop.description: Short label on the floating Stop button on the active-guidance card. Distinct from `home.stopRoute` because the floating CTA only has room for one word.

home.stopRoute.description: Button to end the active route session.

home.suggestedRoutes.description: Header above the route alternatives card when the planner has computed multiple route options.

home.whereTo.description: Search bar placeholder on the home screen.

home.workingOnRoute.description: Status label shown while the planner is computing the route.

planning.cyclingAlternatives.description: Notice on the route alternatives card when all OSM cycling sources succeeded. BRouter and OSRM are tool/brand names and must not be translated.

planning.cyclingAlternativesWithFailures.value: Fahrradalternativen — {failedCount, number} {failedCount, select, one {Quelle} other {Quellen}} nicht verfügbar
planning.cyclingAlternativesWithFailures.description: Notice on the route alternatives card when one or more OSM cycling sources timed out or errored. {failedCount} is the number of failed sources.

planning.mixedRoutesFromHslAndOsm.value: Gemischte Routen aus HSL und OSM
planning.mixedRoutesFromHslAndOsm.description: Notice shown above the route alternatives card when results combine HSL Digitransit and OSM-derived providers. HSL and OSM are brand names — do not translate.

settings.activity.allowBackgroundGps.sub.description: Toggle subtitle for the background-GPS setting.

settings.activity.allowBackgroundGps.tit.description: Toggle title: enables background GPS, gating audio cues and live activity.

settings.activity.audioCues.subtitle.description: Toggle subtitle for the audio-cues setting.

settings.activity.audioCues.title.description: Toggle title: enable spoken turn-by-turn cues during routing.

settings.activity.audioCuesOnlyInBackgro.value: Wenn aus, werden die Hinweise auch abgespielt, während die App geöffnet ist
settings.activity.audioCuesOnlyInBackgro.description: Toggle subtitle for the audio-cues-only-in-background setting.

settings.activity.audioCuesOnlyInBackgro.value: Audio-Hinweise nur, wenn die App im Hintergrund ist
settings.activity.audioCuesOnlyInBackgro.description: Toggle title: when on, cues only play after the user switches away from the app or locks the screen — not while the map is visible on-screen.

settings.activity.keepScreenOn.subtitle.value: Hält das Display wach, während eine Route aktiv ist
settings.activity.keepScreenOn.subtitle.description: Toggle subtitle for the keep-screen-on setting.

settings.activity.keepScreenOn.title.description: Toggle title: keep the device screen awake while a route is active.

settings.activity.liveActivity.subtitle.value: Nächste Abbiegung auf dem Sperrbildschirm anzeigen
settings.activity.liveActivity.subtitle.description: Toggle subtitle for the live-activity setting.

settings.activity.liveActivity.title.description: Toggle title: show the next turn on the lock screen via Live Activity.

settings.activity.title.description: Section header for activity-related toggles on the Settings hub.

settings.distanceUnit.imperial.description: Distance-unit picker option: feet and miles.

settings.distanceUnit.metric.description: Distance-unit picker option: meters and kilometers.

settings.distanceUnit.system.description: Distance-unit picker option meaning 'follow the device system measurement system'.

settings.distanceUnit.title.description: Section header / row label for the distance-unit picker.

settings.hub.device.description: Settings hub row: navigates to ESP32 device pairing/management.

settings.hub.importDiagnostics.description: Settings hub row: navigates to GPX import diagnostics.

settings.hub.importDiagnostics.subtitle.description: Subtitle under the 'Import Diagnostics' row on the Settings hub.

settings.hub.routePlanner.description: Settings hub row: navigates to route-planning preferences.

settings.hub.routePlanner.subtitle.description: Subtitle under the 'Route Planner' row on the Settings hub. HSL is a brand name and must not be translated.

settings.hub.routes.description: Settings hub row: navigates to saved-routes management.

settings.hub.routes.subtitle.description: Subtitle under the 'Routes' row on the Settings hub.

settings.hub.title.description: Title of the Settings hub screen.

settings.language.en.description: Native name of the English language, shown as a Language picker option.

settings.language.fi.description: Native name of the Finnish language (Suomi), shown as a Language picker option. Always presented in the language's own native form, not translated.

settings.language.noVoiceFallback.value: Ihr Browser hat keine Sprachstimme für {language} installiert. Audiohinweise werden auf Englisch abgespielt.
settings.language.noVoiceFallback.description: Warning shown under the Language picker when the active locale has no matching TTS voice. {language} is the native name of the picked language.

settings.language.system.description: Language picker option meaning 'follow the device system language'.

settings.language.title.description: Section header / row label for the app-language picker.

settings.restartRequired.message.value: Beende die App und öffne sie erneut, um die neue Sprache zu übernehmen.
settings.restartRequired.message.description: Body of an alert shown after switching app language on iOS.

settings.restartRequired.title.description: Title of an alert shown after switching app language on iOS.

settings.speedUnit.title.description: Section header / row label for the speed-unit picker.

settings.voiceNotInstalled.value: Die Stimme für {language} ist nicht installiert. Öffne die Systemeinstellungen, um sie zu installieren.
settings.voiceNotInstalled.description: Hint shown in Settings when no TTS voice is available for the active locale.

units.distance.ft.description: Distance value in feet, used in UI labels.

units.distance.km.description: Distance value in kilometers, used in UI labels (not voice cues).

units.distance.m.description: Distance value in meters, used in UI labels (not voice cues).

units.distance.mi.description: Distance value in miles, used in UI labels.

units.duration.min.description: Duration label in minutes, used in UI route summaries.

units.speed.kph.description: Speed unit label: kilometers per hour.

units.speed.mph.description: Speed unit label: miles per hour.
